svg.title: Forkget comic: fork, test, diff, discard
svg.desc: An animated comic about isolated data environments. Start from an immutable snapshot. Read-only branches share the base; writable branches copy the snapshot and become active after provisioning. Connect through the proxy with a MySQL or PostgreSQL client. Insert, update, and delete rows in the writable branch, inspect the net row diff, then drain sessions and discard the branch. The base stays unchanged. Each deployment serves one engine. The animation loops; reduced motion shows a static overview.

g.text: Data environments for trying things out.
dev-alice compared with its pinned snapshot
Discard the branch. Keep the base.
MySQL or PostgreSQL, via the proxy.
